library_name: Unified CDC + Vroom Early Childhood Development Activities

usage_notes.purpose: Research data catalogue with linked source material and preliminary suitability metadata. Not clinically validated recommendations.
usage_notes.source_permission: Supervisor and pediatrician reportedly obtained Vroom activity-use permission; exact scope not independently reviewed.
usage_notes.vroom_instruction_policy: Vroom entries contain concise original descriptors rather than full copyrighted Vroom Tips/Brainy Backgrounds; follow official linked PDFs for originals. LLM should not invent omitted instructions.
usage_notes.source_approval_vs_activity_review: Source-selection approval reported. Individual activity safety/eligibility annotations remain unreviewed.
usage_notes.age_mapping: Checkpoint included only within supplied source age range; boundaries inclusive and warrant specific review.
usage_notes.safety_policy: A review_if_concern flag requires accessibility/suitability review; other flags are not claims of safety. Missing information is unknown, not safe.
usage_notes.retrieval_policy: Use retrieval_eligible_for_internal_research_demo for controlled research testing only; for caregiver-facing deployment require a separate approval switch after review.
usage_notes.frozen_models: No change to ML prediction artifacts, calibration, thresholds or locked-test reports.
usage_notes.content_provenance: CDC records carried from v0.2 as unverified-by-this-pass research paraphrases. Vroom concepts, tip IDs where verified, and age guidance read from official Vroom documents.
